title: How AI is helping Mexico detect breast cancer earlier
key_facts: Al Jazeera reports that Mexico is using AI to speed up breast cancer detection as long waits and a shortage of specialists slow screening.
In the hospital visited by reporter Julia Galiano, AI flags suspicious scans for specialists to review remotely.
quote_evidence: Mexico is turning to AI to speed up breast cancer detection as long waits and a shortage of specialists hamper screening.
Al Jazeera's Julia Galiano visits a hospital where AI flags suspicious scans for specialists to review remotely.
why_it_matters_hint: Where radiologists are scarce, AI triage of mammograms is being used to shorten the queue, though the page gives no numbers.
notes: Video report with a two-sentence description only, no transcript. Modern Ghana carried the same video (403 here). No other outlet with text found via Google News. Treated as headline only.
